selector.rationale: The presence of reddish brown hyperkeratotic papules, compact hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and bandlike lymphocyte infiltrate in the superficial dermis on lesional skin biopsy are more strongly supportive of Necrobiosis Lipoidica.

rejected.label: Granuloma annulare
rejected.why: Lack of distinctive features such as palisading granulomas and less specific clinical presentation compared to Necrobiosis Lipoidica.
